UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Cloud-synced player profile, personal bests, cumulative stats, and game preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player display name shown in cloud profile and stats.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved by the player.

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive landing streak achieved by the player.

totalRuns.description: Total completed runs recorded in the cloud.

totalPerfects.description: Cumulative perfect landings across all recorded runs.

soundEnabled.description: Whether procedural arcade sound effects are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FlipRun.title: FlipRun
FlipRun.description: A single completed Power Flip 3D run log stored under the player's account.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the player.

score.description: Final score achieved during the run.

maxStreak.description: Highest streak achieved during the run.

perfectCount.description: Number of perfect landings during the run.

jumpsCompleted.description: Number of platform jumps completed during the run.

skinId.description: FlipSkin ID used during the run.

themeId.description: RoomTheme ID used during the run.

controlModeId.description: ControlMode ID used during the run.

failReason.description: Optional summary of why the run ended.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the run was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the run was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Player cloud profile, personal bests, and synced preferences.

/users/{userId}/runs/{runId}.description: User-scoped history of completed Power Flip 3D runs.
